sections.title: 1mind is building the next generation of revenue teams.
paras: We are creating a new category of enterprise software: Autonomous Customer Experience. Our platform deploys Superhumans , go-to-market teammates with a face, a voice, and a GTM brain that serve the buyer across the entire journey with one continuous memory. They engage, demo, onboard, and support in the moments no company could ever staff, so the handoffs disappear and growth stops leaking.
Join us as we define the category and build the platform that powers the next generation of revenue teams. When the buyer wins, the company wins. Every1 Wins.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The Solutions Consultant is the technical partner to our Account Executives, from the first technical conversation through close and expansion. You’ll run technical discovery, design how 1mind fits into a prospect’s systems, build custom Superhumans that show buyers their own brand in action, and help build the business case.

The best people in this seat are curious, consultative and keep every technical conversation tied to business outcomes.

sections.title: What You’ll Do

Design the solution: CRM and marketing automation connections, lead routing, APIs, webhooks, MCPs and data flows
Lead technical deep dives and own architecture and security reviews (SOC 2, GDPR, CPRA)
Build custom Superhumans for prospects, turning their content into knowledge a Superhuman can use accurately
Build ROI models and business cases with buyers
Train AEs on the platform and write the talk tracks and playbooks they use every day
Scope implementation, hand off cleanly to Customer Success, and bring field insights back to Product

sections.title: What You’ll Bring
bullets: 4+ years as a Sales Engineer, Solutions Consultant or Solutions Architect in B2B SaaS, selling to GTM buyers (sales, marketing, RevOps), highly preferred
Hands-on experience with CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot, Servicenow, etc) and at least one marketing automation platform preferred
Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks and data flows. You can whiteboard an integration and defend it with an IT team
Experience building with LLMs: prompting, structuring knowledge and testing agent behavior, MCP connections
Strong presence with both executives and technical evaluators
Curiosity and creativity. You tailor every conversation instead of running the same demo
Comfort building process as you go, and a habit of using AI to automate your own work
A background with conversational marketing (Drift, Qualified), conversation intelligence (Gong, Clari) or intent and data platforms (6sense, ZoomInfo)

ashby:1password:f56a7052-4fc3-4cc9-adf1-.summary: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

sections.title: About 1Password
paras: At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

Product Marketing and Enablement connects 1Password’s product strategy to the customer conversations that drive growth. In this Senior Staff individual contributor role, you’ll own the product-to-field motion for Unified Access, Software as a Service (SaaS) Manager, and multi-product expansion, helping Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), and Customer Success Managers (CSMs) connect the needs of Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive buyers to the right solutions. Through clear cross-product storytelling, sales guidance, and close partnership with Product and Sales, you’ll help 1Password advance its mission to unleash employee productivity without compromising security. Reporting to the Director, Product Marketing and Enablement, this role is remote across the United States and Canada.

sections.title: How we’re using AI today
paras: Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.
This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.

sections.title: What we’re looking for:
paras: • A track record of bringing complex technical Business-to-Business (B2B) products, new use cases, or emerging categories to market, with the ability to build product motions spanning discovery, evaluation, technical validation, purchase, adoption, and expansion.
• Familiarity with sales-led enterprise organizations, including complex buying cycles, Account Executives (AEs), Sales Engineers (SEs), technical buyers, and multi-threaded customer opportunities.

• Cross-functional leadership across Product, Engineering, Product Marketing, Sales, and Go-to-Market (GTM) Enablement, with credibility among Information Technology (IT), security, finance, and executive audiences.

sections.title: Preferred qualifications:
paras: • Exposure to launching products, categories, or sales motions in SaaS management, enterprise platforms, cross-sell, or related markets; working with cross-functional buying groups and multi-threaded enterprise deals; using field data, call insights, win-loss feedback, or seller research to prioritize execution; or holding security certifications or equivalent technical training.

ashby:alexai:b834b4cc-1d9f-48bb-8b68-860.summary:
Our mission is to unlock human potential by accelerating hiring.

Alex AI is a platform of AI agents for recruiting. Our agents interview candidates, coordinate next steps, and keep recruiting systems up to date, working together so employers hire great people faster. Customers include First Student, Mattress Firm, and Upwork.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We're hiring our first product marketer, a hands-on role, to refine and amplify the story of Alex. You'll be the connective tissue between our product and the market, owning how we communicate the value we provide, how our brand shows up, and how Alex brings that story to customers.

You'll work with our founders, product, and customers to sharpen our messaging and brand, then build out the sales training, demos, customer proof, and launch material that carry it. You'll join customer conversations, learn what buyers actually ask and where the story falls short, and make sure it works both in the room and out in the world.

Product marketing is the core of this job, and as our first marketer you'll shape everything around it too: how we show up at conferences, which channels we bet on, and what the marketing function becomes as we grow.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Make every seller fluent: own the core materials, talk tracks, demo guides, competitive positioning, objection handling, and customer proof. Train reps and check that they can use it all in real conversations.

Turn every ship into a story: build the AI systems that turn product releases, sales calls, and customer conversations into refined messaging, seller briefings, website copy, and launches, continuously, so the story never goes stale between releases.
Close the loop with customers: use customers response, seller adoption, and real deal feedback to improve the story. Bringing customer questions back into the product.
Run the room: lead our conferences, from planning and budget through onsite execution and follow-up with Sales.
Own what ships: you write the deck, the page, and the talk track yourself. Whatever drafted it, you decide what's true, what's good, and what goes out under our name.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: You're an excellent writer with strong product judgment and creative taste. You can show two or three examples of a message and brand you shaped, explain why it was right for the domain, how sellers used it, and the results it delivered.

You learn products deeply, teach clearly, and stay hands-on from the first idea through the the measurement of results. You demonstrate this in how well you know the products you've worked on and why they were built the way they were.
You build systems that do your work when you’re not in the room. You can show one, whether an AI resource or a knowledge base your team relies on, and say how it could be improved.
You're wonderfully curious in a manner that fosters healthy debate, uncovers new information, and draws those around you closer.
You bring a balanced perspective that grounds "vibes" in quantitative and qualitative evidence you gather yourself.

sections.title: What am I waiting for?
paras: If you’ve gotten this far and building from zero-to-one excites you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.

ashby:assured:77f3d6d8-e2d1-4281-b162-81.summary:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and…

sections.title: Some of the Work You’ll Own:
paras:
🧭 Distill and triage complex issues with strong judgment.
Understand what is being reported, clarify the actual problem, gather the right context, and determine whether it needs deeper investigation, escalation, or connection to an existing project or workstream.

🚦 Act as an air traffic controller across the organization.
Route issues with clear context, urgency, and recommended next steps while balancing multiple priorities. Know when to escalate, when to dig deeper, when to ask for help, and when to keep things moving.

🔎 Turn inbound activity into useful signals and value-driving opportunities.
Look across tickets, customer questions, escalations, and support trends to identify recurring themes, emerging issues, client friction, process gaps, product opportunities, and operational patterns.

sections.title: How You’ll Make an Impact:
paras:
🔍 Help the organization understand what support is telling us.
Surface trends, risks, and recurring friction early so teams can make better product, process, and client decisions.

🤝 Create trust across teams.
Client Engagement, Product, and Engineering need to trust your read on what matters. You’ll earn that trust by being clear, organized, thoughtful, and precise.

📈 Move support beyond reactive ticket resolution.
Help turn support into an operational feedback loop that improves product quality, client experience, internal process, and team focus.

sections.title: You’ll Probably Thrive Here If You:
paras:
🔎 Are naturally curious and investigative.
You like digging into messy problems, asking better questions, and figuring out what is actually happening beneath the surface.

🧠 Can solve problems without a script.
You’re comfortable working through ambiguous, unfamiliar, or messy issues where the next step is not obvious. You can form a hypothesis, test it, pull in the right context, and keep moving without waiting for a playbook.

🧭 Have strong operational judgment.
You understand how work moves through a fast-moving company. You know when to escalate, when to gather more context, when to involve another team, and when to keep something contained.

ashby:cardless:19fd1d40-f2be-4ad8-834a-c.summary:
Cardless is building the infrastructure for the world's best companies to design, build, and launch financial products. Companies like Coinbase and Bilt use Cardless to create credit cards that feel entirely their own. In an industry where branded financial products usually mean shared logos and shared control, Cardless is built to disappear. Our APIs and components shape the journey from the first application to every purchase, reward, and moment of support that follows, while we handle lending, compliance, and operations behind the scenes.

In September 2025, we raised a $60 million Series C led by Spark Capital, bringing our total funding to $170 million. The team is over 70 people and scaling toward profitability by year-end 2026.

sections.title: About Cardless
paras: We're looking for kind, humble people with high standards and low egos. We take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. We see what could be improved, make it so, and leave every product, system, and team better than we found it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: The ledger sits at the heart of Cardless's financial infrastructure. It is the source of truth for every transaction and balance, and a critical foundation for how we launch and scale financial products. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own this area and help us build for the scale and complexity ahead.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the vision and roadmap for Cardless's ledger, set priorities, and make the trade-offs needed to support the business as we scale.
Define how money movement is recorded, including authorizations, holds, settlements, reversals, refunds, disputes, fees, and payments across credit and debit.
Ensure the ledger is a trusted source of truth, with the controls and reconciliation needed to keep balances complete and accurate.
Make the ledger a shared foundation across products and partners, so we can add new products and money-movement types without rebuilding the underlying accounting logic.

Partner deeply with engineering on the ledger design and how it interacts with the rest of the stack, from data models and system boundaries to how transactions flow across authorization, payments, disputes, risk, and finance, and how we handle failures and consistency.
Ensure the ledger scales reliably with the business, with clear financial state, end-to-end traceability, and the tooling needed to investigate and resolve issues quickly.
Build toward automated financial operations, using automation to improve reconciliation, balance validation, anomaly detection, and exception handling while keeping the right controls in place.
Work closely with processors and bank partners on the systems and integrations that connect into the ledger.

sections.title: Who you are
bullets: You've built or owned a ledger, core banking system, or issuing processor at a bank, neobank, processor, or BaaS platform.
You're excited about how AI and automation can change financial infrastructure, from how financial operations are run to how teams investigate issues, reconcile accounts, and manage exceptions.
You're technically strong and comfortable going deep with engineers on data models, transaction lifecycles, system boundaries, failure modes, and the edge cases that come with moving money.
You think in systems and understand how ledger decisions affect risk, finance, operations, compliance, and the customer experience.
You understand how infrastructure decisions translate into better products, and you can solve today's needs while building capabilities we can expand over time.
You understand the rigor that comes with building systems that move and account for money. You don't trade accuracy, reliability, controls, and audibility for speed.

ashby:decagon:95524337-b5e7-4156-9022-af.summary:

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

sections.title: About Decagon
paras: We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

sections.title: About the Team
paras: When a Fortune 500 C-suite brings in Decagon, they are not buying a support tool. They are buying a transformation of how their customers experience their brand, end to end. Agent Product Managers are the people they trust to make that transformation real.

Your counterpart is the C-suite, and what they are asking you to transform is their entire customer experience. You define the roadmap, the frameworks, and the decision-making models that make a top-down transformation feel safe to bet on. You hold that relationship from the first pre-sales conversation through the life of the account.

The work compounds in a way most roles don't. Every flagship deployment you lead feeds directly into our playbooks and raises the quality of every build that follows. Hard-won lessons on your accounts become leverage across the whole company, and the IP you create outlives any single agent.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Decagon is hiring a Senior Agent Product Manager, Healthcare to own the delivery, adoption, and expansion of AI solutions for our healthcare customers across Payer, Provider, Pharmacy, Labs, and Life Sciences. You are the primary technical and strategic owner on the account: you earn trust with the customer's leadership, scope a solution that solves their problem, and then build the working AI agent.

You will be among the first dedicated healthcare Agent PMs on the team, working alongside Healthcare product and GTM leadership to author our healthcare roadmap and strategy. You'll partner with Strategic Account Directors, Agent Strategy Managers, and Agent Deployment Engineers to scale agents in production and grow them into core infrastructure for how the customer runs.

It is a rare combination: the executive influence of a top strategy consulting leader, the instincts of a product builder, and the ownership of a founder. If you've ever wanted to build the solution instead of hand off the recommendation, this role was designed for you. You own the outcome end to end, on the highest-stakes accounts in healthcare, with all of Decagon's cross-functional teams behind you.

sections.title: In this role, you will
bullets: Own the AI transformation and technical deployment for Decagon's largest healthcare opportunities, partnering with Sales, Solutions Engineers, and Agent Deployment Engineers to build working agents that turn sophisticated, skeptical, compliance-gated buyers into signed customers.

Serve as the executive partner to the C-suite of Fortune 500 companies, defining and driving their AI transformation roadmap and owning the relationship from first conversation through production and expansion.

Design, build, and optimize enterprise-grade agents for high-volume healthcare workflows: benefits and eligibility, claims and prior authorization status, patient access and scheduling, Rx and adherence outreach, care-gap closure, post-discharge follow-up, and HCP inquiry handling.

ashby:goodie-ai:d9c2977c-920d-4bae-94e9-.summary:

ashby:healthleap:cfd767f1-5e63-4f27-98f8.summary:

Ivo builds AI products that helps companies like Meta, Uber, IBM, Intel, DoorDash, Mitsubishi Electric, and Coinbase solve their most difficult contracting problems. We think that large language models have created an opportunity to fundamentally change how businesses collaborate with each other.

At Ivo you will work on challenging problems with colleagues who have high standards for each other, move fast, and care deeply about their craft.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: We are looking for a product marketer to help define, evolve, and execute go-to-market strategies for Ivo’s AI contract review and intelligence products. You will develop messaging, positioning, and product narratives that make it clear who our products are for, what problems they solve, and why Ivo is different.

You will work closely with Sales, Product, Enablement, and Marketing to drive product adoption, customer engagement, and growth. Ivo ships quickly, is expanding from legal into procurement, and competes in a market that changes every week. You will be a close partner to the GTM team, help scale how we learn from wins and losses, and keep our competitive guidance useful and current.

sections.title: What You’ll Own
bullets: Be a close partner to the GTM team, giving reps and CSMs the context, messaging, materials, and talk tracks they need to sell new products and features.
Scale Ivo’s win-loss process, synthesize what we learn from customers and deals, and turn those findings into plans that GTM, Product, Enablement, and other Marketing teams can act on.
Keep Ivo’s competitive view current by tracking the market and maintaining practical battlecards, comparison guidance, and objection handling for the GTM team.
Take on high-priority GTM needs, from one-page collateral and vertical positioning to persona and use-case messaging for procurement and new buyer segments.
Bring customer feedback, recurring objections, reasons we win, and market changes back into Ivo’s positioning, messaging, and product conversations.

sections.title: Skills You'll Need to Bring
bullets: 3–7 years of product marketing or closely related B2B SaaS experience, with the level calibrated to the work you have owned and the results you have delivered.
Strong writing and synthesis skills. You can turn complex product, customer, and market information into clear messaging and useful materials.
Experience partnering with GTM teams to launch, sell, and drive adoption of complex products.
Comfort interviewing customers and turning qualitative feedback into clear findings and plans.
Good judgment about where to spend time when launches, competitive work, customer research, and GTM requests are all moving at once.
A proactive, self-directed style. You can build a new process without waiting for a mature playbook.
Experience with win-loss analysis, competitive marketing, field enablement, legal technology, procurement, or vertical SaaS is helpful but not required.

sections.title: Ivo Might Be a Good Fit for You If
bullets: You have a "do what it takes" attitude, willing to dive into problems and solve them yourself
You'd describe yourself as relentlessly resourceful
You have a strong internal sense of urgency, a bias toward doing things today rather than tomorrow
You move fast, communicate clearly, and know where process helps and where it doesn't
Startup experience is preferred but not required
You're excited about the adventure of building a company

ashby:jobber:b47c8ae4-225b-46f5-a6aa-9f6.summary:
Then Jobber might be the place for you! We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our New Starts team, helping the next generation of home service businesses make it past their toughest years.

Jobber exists to help home service businesses be successful, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

sections.title: Are you a dynamic product manager with a passion for impacting small businesses?
paras: Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers .

sections.title: The team:
paras: Every service business starts somewhere: a truck, a trade skill, a handful of first customers, and an owner who has never run a business before. The first years are the hardest, and too many promising businesses don’t make it through them.

The New Starts team exists to change those odds. Our mission is to help new service businesses become stable, growing companies. We work across the whole journey: the first trial and the critical early weeks in the product, and the path from “just getting started” to “growing with confidence.”

This is an exciting mandate, and it is deliberately different. We are accountable for whether new businesses succeed, not for a single funnel stage or a conversion number. We spend time with new owners, we favour customer-first bets over short-term metric wins, and we work hand in hand with cross-functional teams building Jobber’s AI-powered customer journey. If you want to build something meaningful from a blank page, this is that team.

sections.title: The role:
paras: Reporting to the Director of Product Management, the Senior Product Manager will contribute to the product strategy for New Starts and own the roadmap that brings it to life. You will work closely with Engineering, Design, and Go-To-Market stakeholders, alongside fellow Customer Experience Product Managers, to turn that strategy into experiences new owners feel in their first days and in their first year.
bullets: Contribute to the vision and strategy for New Starts , defining the outcomes that matter for new businesses and the leading indicators that tell us we’re on track, then own the roadmap that gets us there.
Lead discovery with new owners. Meet with new service businesses regularly, uncover what makes the difference between stalling and growing, and turn what you learn into clear priorities.
Lead end-to-end product development across the journey , from free tools that create value to the moments where a new business is ready to grow.
Build growth loops and run experiments that connect out-of-product and in-product experiences, balancing short-term wins with long-term bets.
Use AI to make the journey personal , partnering with the teams building Jobber’s AI-powered recommendation engine and customer journey platform to meet each new owner where they are.
Align and influence across the organization , bringing Engineering, Design, and GTM teams around a shared view of what great looks like for a new business.
Monitor and report on performance of your initiatives to senior leadership, linking the work to the outcomes we’re accountable for.

sections.title: What success looks like
paras: Within your first six months, you will have:
bullets: Spoken with dozens of new service business owners and shared what you’ve learned across the company.
Shipped your first bets.
Set the roadmap for the next two quarters.

bullets: Own intake and triage of requests coming into the Core team from Engineering, Customer Success, Sales, and Support - while also remaining abreast of interactions with our large open source community

Run the product side of the team's sprint ceremonies such as backlog grooming planning, refinement, reviews
Make the day-to-day decisions that inevitably come up mid-cycle: scope tradeoffs, edge cases, security questions, behavior questions, what's good enough to ship
Make sure open source releases are planned and communicated well, release notes, community expectations, and how a change lands for practitioners
Triage GitHub issues and engage with contributors alongside the engineering team
Demo work in progress, including features that are experimental, to internal teams and customers to get feedback early
Run the research that feeds Core direction, customer and partner calls, competitive and community signal, usage patterns

Hands-on technical ability. You can stand up a NetBox instance, install and configure plugins, work through the API, and demo something that isn't finished yet without getting lost
Comfortable in a codebase: you can read a pull request, follow a technical design doc, and hold a real conversation with engineers about implementation tradeoffs
Strong execution habits. You run sprint ceremonies well, keep a backlog clean, make decisions quickly when they're yours to make, and know when to escalate
Solid API and data model instincts. You understand REST and GraphQL, versioning, and backward compatibility, and you know a schema change is a contract with everyone building on top of it
Product judgment on platform decisions. You've shaped a data model, schema, or API surface before, and you can make the case for a change with customer evidence and hold it with engineers
Clear communicator across audiences. you can explain an upcoming feature to an engineer, a CSM, and a customer, and adjust for each

Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

As a Product Manager for Connectivity Platform, you'll own the platform capabilities that keep Plaid's data supply reliable and efficient, and you'll decide which ones we build as the network evolves. You'll drive the discovery that finds the highest-value work, own the roadmap, and partner closely with engineering to weigh technical trade-offs against business value. Spend deep time with internal teams that depend on the platform to understand their needs and wants, with the ability to distill the information into actionable requests and raise that to the platform team

ashby:ramp:fc971889-db1d-4a20-a25e-f282f.summary:
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

sections.title: About Ramp
paras: The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Ramp builds software that moves real money, from bill payments and corporate cards to reimbursements, accounting integrations, and travel. Our customers rely on us to keep their operations running: invoices get paid, books get closed, and finance leaders can trust the data behind every decision.

In this role, you will be the person who spots where customers are getting stuck and drives issues to a clear resolution. You will learn a complex product deeply enough to troubleshoot across payments, bank linking, accounting syncs, and card programs, then partner with teams across Engineering, Risk, Product, and Partnerships to get problems solved. This is not script-based support. You will triage, investigate, and make high-signal judgment calls throughout the day.
You will thrive in this role if you are a systems thinker and deeply customer obsessed. Support is the baseline. How you think about improving processes, tools, and outcomes is what sets you apart.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Be the voice of Ramp's Customer Support. You'll spend your day engaging with customers, primarily via live calls, email, and chat.
Diagnose across a broad product surface. Ramp isn't one product — it's payments, cards, travel, accounting integrations, and more. You'll need to understand how they connect and where they break.

Build and shape AI tools, not just use them. Ramp is building AI into CX operations. You'll use AI-powered research tools and proprietary tools like Glass daily, provide direct feedback on what's working, and play an active role in how these tools evolve. You're not just a user — you're a builder. We are all builders at Ramp.

Communicate with precision and empathy. Our customers are financially sophisticated. You need to explain what's happening, what you're doing about it, and what they should expect — clearly and without filler.

sections.title: What You Need
bullets: You're a systems thinker: you don't just solve the ticket in front of you, you ask why the problem exists and how to prevent it from happening again.
You actively use AI tools — Claude, Notion AI, research and workflow tools — and can demonstrate how you've applied them to get real work done. This is a hard requirement.
You're fast-moving while holding yourself to a high bar for execution: you balance speed, accuracy, and thoroughness in every interaction.
You can hold a technical conversation about how systems connect (APIs, bank integrations, accounting software) even if you're not writing code.
You manage competing priorities without dropping things. When you have 15 open issues across 4 internal teams, nothing falls through.
You write clearly and concisely. You can explain a payment reconciliation issue to a CFO without jargon.
You're comfortable on the phone. Many interactions start there.
You have a demonstrated track record of exceeding key performance standards, including CSAT, QA, and speed-of-service metrics.

ashby:revenuecat:1881e14c-7cc9-45de-ba1e.summary:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $18B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 180+ people across 30+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that…

sections.title: The Role
paras: As Senior Product Manager, Ad Monetization, you'll join a small product and engineering team building RevenueCat's next generation of monetization products for app developers.

Ads at RevenueCat are early, but we’re no longer starting from zero. We’ve launched ad revenue tracking and rewarded-ad infrastructure, with strong early adoption. Our next chapter is helping developers earn more from ads: building products that connect publisher inventory with demand, improve monetization performance, and make ad monetization easier to adopt and operate.

You'll report to our product lead for Ads and become the primary IC product owner for ad monetization. You'll own significant parts of the roadmap end-to-end: understanding customer problems, identifying opportunities, forming hypotheses, working closely with engineering and design, shipping quickly, and using what we learn to determine what comes next.

sections.title: About you:
bullets: You have 5+ years of experience owning product decisions end-to-end. Your title may have been Product Manager, founder, or something else — what's important is that you've been accountable for deciding what to build and whether it worked.

You've built and shipped publisher-facing ad monetization products for mobile apps, and have firsthand experience solving the product, technical, and business problems involved in helping developers monetize ad inventory.
You deeply understand the mechanics of mobile ad monetization, including how publisher inventory, demand sources, auctions, pricing, mediation, and measurement interact.
You understand the incentives of the different participants in the ad ecosystem and can reason about both the technical and commercial implications of product decisions.
You are excited about RevenueCat's mission to help developers make more money and about expanding that mission beyond subscriptions.
You have an entrepreneurial mindset and are excited to take an initiative with early traction and help turn it into a significant product area.
You are sufficiently technical to work closely with engineering on SDKs, APIs, integrations, data flows, and other technical product decisions.
You have demonstrated the ability to ship and learn quickly, including finding pragmatic solutions to hard problems with many constraints.

sections.title: In the first month, you'll:
bullets: Build a deep understanding of what's live today, including ad revenue tracking, rewarded-ad infrastructure, and virtual currency and entitlement flows.
Spend significant time talking with customers using these products to understand what's working, what isn't, and where the biggest opportunities may be.
Build strong working relationships with your engineering, product, design, data, and go-to-market counterparts.
Develop context on our existing strategy, customer research, technical architecture and the hypotheses behind our current roadmap.
Begin contributing your own perspective on where RevenueCat should invest next.

sections.title: Within the first 3 months, you'll:
bullets: Take ownership of a meaningful portion of the ad monetization roadmap.
Work closely with engineering to identify the fastest and most effective ways to validate our next set of product hypotheses.
Ship or meaningfully advance your first product bets.
Establish a strong understanding of the opportunities, constraints, and tradeoffs that should shape our roadmap.
Effectively collaborate with senior stakeholders on priorities for the area.

sections.title: About The Role
paras: Built Technologies is transforming how capital moves through construction and real estate finance — one of the largest, most complex sectors in the economy. Built's Revenue Enablement team equips our revenue organization with the skills, content, and processes needed to perform at a high level — and the Revenue Enablement Specialist is an independently operating contributor who designs and delivers the training programs and content that make that happen. sections.title: Our Guiding Principles
bullets: Be Bold. We pursue the biggest problems in our industry, challenge assumptions others take for granted, and take calculated risks to get there. We don't hide behind consensus or committees. Playing it safe is just failing slowly.

Help Customers Win. We learn our customers' businesses deeply — how they think, how they deploy capital, what keeps them up at night. We treat their capital like our own. We ship leverage, not features. And we measure ourselves by customer results, not our intentions.
Move with Urgency & Purpose. We bias toward delivery over perfection, remove friction from our own paths, and communicate in real time. Momentum compounds — and we build it every day.
Own the Outcome. We own outcomes, not just tasks. We hold a high Say:Do ratio and take responsibility from idea through impact. When something breaks, we fix it — we don't wait to be asked.
Never Satisfied. We raise the bar continuously. We stay curious, hold exacting standards, debate hard, and hold our opinions loosely when the evidence shifts. Excellence is a habit, not an event.

You'll be the person other teams turn to for the accurate, current answer on how Nametag describes itself across sales conversations, the website, analyst briefings, and every deck in between.

sections.title: Role Overview
paras: As Director of Product Marketing, you will own positioning and messaging for Nametag's core identity verification platform, and be the point of accountability for keeping that message consistent as the company grows quickly. You will lead messaging and materials creation for new product launches, build and maintain the sales enablement and competitive materials our go-to-market teams rely on daily, keep strict documentation of all product features and new releases, and partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Growth Marketing, Channel Partnerships, and Product Management. You’ll also have particularly close ties to the ITSM and IAM integration ecosystem (Okta, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, Zendesk).

sections.title: Positioning & Messaging
bullets: Own Nametag's core-IDV narratives, and serve as the arbiter of how they're positioned across every customer-facing surface.
Maintain and enforce the company's messaging and style guide: sourcing rules, canonical terminology, approved claims, so the same product doesn't end up with different language in the market at once.
Translate product capabilities into messaging that holds up for a CISO, a security/IAM leader, an IT leader, and a helpdesk leader; the buyers and influencers Nametag sells into.

sections.title: Product Launches & Go-to-Market

Define and track launch success metrics in partnership with Product Management and Marketing Ops.

greenhouse:neurahealth:5174278007.summary: Neura Health is a nationwide, doctor-led practice built to eliminate the barriers between patients and life-changing care. As the country's leading virtual neurology clinic, we provide an all-in-one longitudinal platform where cutting-edge technology meets specialized expertise to manage the entire spectrum of neurological diseases. While traditional brick-and-mortar clinics are at a breaking point, forcing patients to endure dangerous 4-6 month wait times, Neura is scaling the nation’s largest virtual practice to deliver immediate access to the 145 million Americans in need. Through strategic partnerships with leading health systems, pharmaceutical innovators, and large clinics, as well as a direct-to-patient model, we are fundamentally transforming the referral landscape and reducing average wait time from 276 days to 5 days.

sections.title: About Neura:
paras: Our tech-enabled model provides a comprehensive, end-to-end experience that goes far beyond a standard consultation. We offer patients seamless access to personalized care plans and expert care navigation, ensuring no one has to manage their journey alone. This mission is powered by our multidisciplinary specialized care teams, which include world-class physicians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and dedicated care coaches. We leverage AI-powered workflow optimization and continuous monitoring for everything from chronic headaches and epilepsy to complex memory disorders. Backed by $22M in funding from world-class investors, we are not just improving neurology; we are revolutionizing it. We are looking for purpose-driven innovators to join us in making high-quality brain health a reality for everyone.

sections.title: About the Role
paras: Neura has proven the model: real patients, real partners, real revenue. The next job is making the product as good as the care. As our first dedicated Product Manager, you will decide what we build next and how quickly we learn whether it worked.

You will report to the SVP of Operations and collaborate with our CTO and tech team. Your days will move across functions: inside our operations with the support team, care navigators, and providers, because that is where the best product problems live. You’ll work alongside and set the priorities for engineering, turning what you find into prototypes, priorities, and shipped improvements.
Three outcomes guide the work: more follow-up visits, more efficient and effective provider workflows, and less overhead per visit through AI and automation.

sections.title: What You’ll Do
bullets: Prioritize with conviction. Develop and maintain a clear roadmap across patient, provider, partner, and internal tools. Weigh impact on visit retention, provider time, and business outcomes, staying focused on what matters most, and explain why.
Turn operational insight into product. Work daily with support, care teams, and providers. Combine what you see with NPS, CSAT, reviews, and other metrics to find the problems worth solving.

Iterate in days, not quarters . Prototype ideas, put them in front of real users quickly, learn, and adjust. Bring engineering well-framed problems and just enough written detail to build confidently.
Make follow-up and provider workflows better . Improve the path from onboarding to the next booked visit, and cut the administrative friction in documentation, orders, referrals, and handoffs.

Apply AI where it removes manual work . Find the highest-value automation opportunities, prototype them, and work with the tech team to evaluate and ship them, with humans in the loop where care is involved.
Land what you ship . Train and support the teams who use each release, check that it landed, and use data to measure success.

sections.title: What You'll Work On
paras: You will help shape the next generation of Neura's product end to end, including how we document and guide care, how we make sure patients follow through, and the scheduling, onboarding, and data foundations beneath them. You will also help answer the hard questions: what we build versus partner for, and how AI earns clinician trust in a regulated setting.

Our Marketing team is lean but powerful, and each of us brings a diverse opinion and perspective because that is what we seek out and respect in others. paras: Small businesses are at the heart of every neighborhood, and most are short on time, passionate about their craft, and careful with every dollar. As our Product Marketing Manager for SMB, you will uncover what truly motivates a local business owner to show up on Nextdoor, earn the trust of their neighbors, and eventually advertise. You will own the SMB product marketing strategy, translating customer insights and long-range business goals into positioning, launches, and growth loops that fuel product-led growth.

You will be the voice of the small business owner in product decisions, including 0-to-1 product requirements, and a resourceful operator who finds unconventional ways to reach them. You will use AI as a daily partner to create, investigate, and collaborate, and you will help deliver new experiences to millions of customers worldwide over the next year.

You should be entrepreneurial, endlessly curious, strategic, and willing to roll up your sleeves. If you want the challenge of fast-paced growth, the satisfaction of helping local businesses succeed in every community, and the pride of helping build a talented marketing team, this is the place for you. We strive to give employees the opportunity to make a big impact in the company and in the market.

sections.title: Your responsibilities
bullets: Build first-hand understanding of small business owners: their goals, what success looks like to them, and what makes them engage in community and choose to advertise. Talk to them regularly.
Be the product expert, internally and externally, for our small business customers and partners.
Develop impactful positioning and breakthrough messaging that makes Nextdoor's value to local businesses clear and differentiated.

Identify and prioritize the most promising opportunities to grow SMB adoption. Design and run low-cost or no-cost growth experiments (e.g. partnerships, local associations, earned and community-led channels, referrals, product-led loops), and turn the wins into repeatable approaches. Share what you learn, including the misses.
Lead product launches and feature releases across multiple channels to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention.
Use AI daily to create, investigate, and collaborate: synthesize customer signal, prototype messaging and campaigns, analyze data, and build repeatable workflows your teammates can adopt.
Identify insights from the competitive landscape, voice of customer, NPS, and market trends, and turn them into recommendations that shape and influence the product roadmap.
Build analytical business cases and measurable KPIs for experiments and product marketing plans. Evaluate results and recommend where to scale, change direction, or stop investment.

paras: This is a highly visible role. bullets: 5+ years in product marketing or growth marketing.
Deep, demonstrated understanding of small business owners, backed by specific examples of what drives them to engage, build a presence, and spend on advertising.

Real AI fluency. Show us how you use AI to create, investigate, and collaborate, how you share what works, and how you check the quality of AI-generated work.
Entrepreneurial instinct and genuine curiosity about helping small businesses succeed. Experience running or working closely with a small business, side project, or 0-to-1 launch is a plus.
Exceptional written and verbal communication, including presenting to senior leadership.
A collaborator who builds strong relationships across functions and seniority levels, and who gives and receives constructive feedback respectfully.

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive the adoption of identity security in AI applications.

Tigera secures AI agents on any Kubernetes platform, from the kernel with eBPF. With Tigera Lynx, enterprises run AI agents in production and stay in control: Lynx discovers every agent, governs every call, contains any agent that steps out of line, and keeps a record of what each one did.

Tigera created Project Calico, which secures more than 8 million Kubernetes nodes every day, and the commercial Calico platform is trusted by Global 2000 enterprises including NVIDIA, Royal Bank of Canada, Chipotle, Bloomberg, and GoDaddy.

If you are looking to help make a substantial impact, and our values and products align with your vision of your career growth, we want to hear from you!

sections.title: The Opportunity
paras: AI agents are reaching production faster than security teams can govern them, and Lynx is how we help them do it. We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Architect in Vancouver to act as the number two for Lynx presales across North America.

This is a senior role with direct influence on where the product and the business go. You’ll run the most important Lynx deals in the region, work closely with our VP of PM on the roadmap, and be the person customers, partners and our own sales team turn to when they want to understand what Lynx does and why it matters. The category is still being defined, and so is how we sell into it, so you’ll help shape both.

This role is ideal for a forward-thinking pre-sales professional or platform/security engineer eager to spearhead AI agent security while the category is being defined. You don’t need to be an AI expert on day one, if you bring strong Kubernetes and application security foundations along with a passion for how AI systems are built, we will help you build the required expertise.

sections.title: What You Will Do
bullets: Technical Sales Leadership: Drive end-to-end technical evaluation wins across key Lynx accounts in North America—guiding engagements from early discovery and proof-of-concept validation through final execution with high win conversion rates.
Discovery & Problem Solving: Rapidly uncover root enterprise challenges, distinguishing core business requirements from initial requests to engineer tailored, impactful solution architectures.
Objection Handling: Convert prospect pushback into actionable criteria by accurately diagnosing functional gaps, educational needs, or strategic deal alignment.
Resource & Scope Governance: Qualify engagements early to safeguard product roadmaps and engineering bandwidth, gracefully refocusing or disengaging from unqualified prospects.
Product & CTO Collaboration: Partner directly with product management and executive leadership to influence product strategy using prioritized, real-world field insights and deal evidence.
Regional Technical Ownership: Serve as the primary technical lead for Lynx in North America, establishing gold-standard PoC benchmarks while mentoring account executives and solutions engineers.
Thought Leadership & Evangelism: Champion Lynx across industry events, analyst briefings, and community workshops, delivering compelling content on securing modern AI workloads.
Sales Enablement Assets: Design scalable reference architectures, reusable demonstration environments, and PoC execution frameworks for global field enablement.

sections.title: What You Bring
bullets: Proven Pre-Sales Track Record: At least 8 years in customer-facing technical positions (e.g., Solutions Architect, Field CTO, Sales Engineer), with a strong history of closing complex enterprise infrastructure and security deals.
Early-Stage Category Creation: Background serving as a founding or pioneer SA for a novel technology, building value propositions, demonstration kits, and evaluation frameworks from the ground up.
Discovery & Deal Qualification: Sharp strategic judgment to differentiate high-intent buyers from low-value opportunities, along with the discipline to disengage when appropriate.

Roadmap Influence & Leadership Alignment: Ability to partner with product managers and executives to guide product strategy, holding technical credibility to challenge both prospective clients and internal teams.
Kubernetes & Container Expertise: Deep practical knowledge of container orchestration, capable of constructing environments and troubleshooting active environments live in customer settings.
Cloud & Application Security Fundamentals: Firm foundation in network policies, Zero Trust frameworks, workload identity mechanisms, and cloud platform controls.
Identity Architecture Knowledge: Technical understanding of authentication protocols, including mTLS, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, and JWT generation or verification.
Public Cloud Proficiency: Direct engineering experience operating within major cloud environments such as GCP, Azure, or AWS.

Experience with Calico, Cilium, OpenShift or eBPF

greenhouse:tines:6217973004.summary:
Tines is the complete environment for enterprise AI, trusted by organizations like Reddit, SAP, Mars, Fin, and Headspace. Tines gives all teams a safe, scalable way to turn their expertise into software, whatever their technical background.

Since its founding in 2018, Tines has enabled over 600 enterprise customers to run their most important work, where reliability and security aren't optional. From IT and business operations to security and beyond, Tines empowers teams to build apps, agents and automations to solve complex problems and bring their ideas to life.

Founded by Eoin Hinchy and Thomas Kinsella and co-headquartered in Dublin and Boston, Tines is truly agnostic and helps organizations bring their entire technology stack – any model, any tool, any system, any infrastructure – together.

sections.title: About the role
paras: In this role, you’ll develop a customer-centric narrative for Tines’ platform capabilities. You’ll work closely with product, engineering, commercial, and marketing teams to turn technical capabilities into clear positioning, compelling content, and effective product launches.

IT will be a priority audience, and you’ll help us reach customers and decision-makers across other lines of business. Working alongside our audience product marketers, you’ll connect a consistent platform story to the problems different business teams need to solve.

You’ll be a leading voice on where Tines fits in the evolving AI landscape. This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys building with the product, forming a defensible point of view, and turning that thinking into work our teams and customers can use.

sections.title: What you will be doing:
bullets: Market research. Conduct customer interviews and win/loss research, follow AI developments, and contribute to analyst engagement. Turn what you learn into recommendations for our positioning and go-to-market approach.
Competitive intelligence. Understand emerging competitors and established alternatives. Translate research into differentiation, battlecards, objection-handling resources, and training.
Positioning and messaging. Create a clear narrative for what customers can build, run, and monitor with Tines. Partner with product marketers to make it relevant to IT and expanded audiences.
Product launches. Lead product marketing for new platform capabilities, from identifying audiences and use cases through launch messaging, content, enablement, and measurement.

Enablement. Partner with Sales Enablement and customer-facing teams to build confidence in our positioning and equip them to address questions from customers, business decision-makers, and technical evaluators.

Content and collateral. Create practical resources, including blogs, decks, webinars, guides, and product collateral. Work with Content Strategy and experts across engineering, solution engineering, customer success, and support to make our story accurate, credible, and useful.

sections.title: What you bring with you:
paras: At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. A variety of experience, perspectives, and voices makes us the company we are . We’d love to hear from you.

Tines provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to sex, race, colour, ethnic or social origin, genetic features, language, religion or belief, political or any other opinion, membership of a national minority, property, birth, disability, age or sexual orientation.

Strong understanding of inference systems in the context of open source LLMs including common serving engines (vLLM, SGLang, Tensor-RT) , testing frameworks (benchmarking), optimization techniques, and production system design.
Proficiency in Python and skilled at using agents for diagnosing, testing, and building

paras: Together AI, the AI Native Cloud, is purpose-built for AI engineers. Trusted by Cursor, Decagon, ElevenLabs, Salesforce, and Zoom, Together serves 400+ trillion tokens a month.

paras: Please read each role carefully and apply to the position best suited to you. Candidates are limited to 6 applications within a 90-day period, and applications beyond that limit will be automatically rejected. You may apply to additional roles 90 days after your last application.

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

greenhouse:xometry:5275417007.summary:
Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to own that experience end to end. You sit between Sales and the quoting teams and you serve the customers who matter most to Xometry. Your job is to rethink how a request becomes a priced quote: every channel it can arrive through, every hand-off between a person and a system, and every step that does not need a human at all. You will design the agents that read the request, build the quote, and propose the price, the Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations that let those agents work…

sections.title: How You'll Contribute
bullets: Build the staff tools the quoting and sales teams actually use. Own the internal quote review, pricing, and quote summary tools. Treat adoption as the product metric: a tool the team routes around has failed, regardless of what shipped.

Instrument everything. Every human pricing decision (override, margin change, lead-time adjustment) becomes structured data that improves the next prediction and the next agent run. Write your own queries, build your own dashboards, and put the events you need into the requirements document, not into an analyst request.

Set product strategy and secure buy-in. Define a 6 to 12 month roadmap for agentic quoting, sequence it by customer impact and speed, and align Engineering, Data Science, Sales, Quoting Operations, and Finance behind it. Present progress against named outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.

Build and ship with AI agents. Operate spec-first. Read the relevant systems with agentic tools, ask sharper feasibility questions as a result, and write specs that an engineer can hand to a coding agent. Prototype in Cursor, Claude, and Figma Make before you write requirements.
Raise the bar for peers. Share the AI workflows that worked and the ones that failed. Your patterns should show up in other product managers' artifacts.

sections.title: What You'll Bring to Xometry
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, including direct ownership of a workflow or operations product that sits between a sales or service organization and the customers it serves, in a B2B, marketplace, or enterprise context.
Evidence of shipping AI or automation into an expert human workflow with guardrails, and of knowing when not to automate.
Experience integrating products across systems of record (CRM, ERP, file storage, messaging), and a working understanding of how agents connect to those systems through tool protocols such as MCP.
Multi-channel thinking: you have redesigned how requests enter a business (email, text, forms, APIs, agents) and can show the drop-off you removed.

AI-native practice, not just AI tool use: you can show where AI changed a decision your team made, not only where it saved you time. Hands-on fluency with Cursor, Claude, or equivalent agentic tools, and a point of view on evaluating large language model (LLM) features before and after launch.
Strong analytical fluency: you write your own SQL, you have built your own dashboard, and you have caught a broken metric before it misled a decision.
Operational curiosity: you learn how a process actually runs by sitting with the people who run it, and you earn their trust before you change their tools.
Exceptional written communication: your documents let an operations lead, an engineer, and an executive act on the same page.

sections.title: Signals we look for
bullets: You can walk through a specific request-to-fulfillment funnel you redesigned across a sales team, a service team, and their customers: the channels involved, the steps you removed, the before and after numbers, and how adoption went.

You have built or owned an integration between an AI agent and a system of record, and you can explain what the agent was allowed to do, what it had to ask a human for, and how you knew when it was wrong.
You have shipped an AI or machine learning (ML) feature into a human-in-the-loop process and can describe its evaluation criteria, its failure modes, and what you monitored after launch.

You can point to a case where your team decided differently because of an AI-driven workflow you built (continuous customer signal, prototype-first decisions, evaluation criteria written before build).
You have worked in manufacturing, supply chain, pricing, or quoting, or you can show how you learn an unfamiliar operational domain fast.

sections.title: Pace
paras: This is a startup pace inside a public company. You will be given a metric and an open problem, not a scoped project plan, and you will be expected to move quickly from hypothesis to shipped test. If you do your best work with a clear brief and a stable backlog, this is not the right role.

lever:azul:698a1476-48f1-47ec-b770-5b17f.summary:
The Azul Sales Engineer is a hands-on, deeply technical pre-sales leader responsible for delivering the technical win across opportunities within their territory. Azul sells to the most demanding Java estates in the world — enterprises running mission-critical, high-throughput, latency-sensitive applications on the JVM — so this role demands genuine engineering depth, not just presentation polish.

A Sales Engineer earns credibility with engineers, architects, and executives alike by getting hands on : running technical evaluations in the customer’s own environment, tuning the JVM, interpreting GC and performance data, and translating measurable technical outcomes into clear business value. Beyond individual deals, the Sales Engineer uses their experience to mentor and uplevel the broader SE team.

sections.title: What You'll Do (aka Responsibilities)
bullets: Own the technical win. Drive pre-sales engagements end to end — discovery of the prospect’s business and technical challenges, mapping Azul portfolio capabilities to those challenges, and validating the solution through demonstration and hands-on proof.

Lead hands-on pilots. Design, scope, and personally execute product pilots and proofs-of-concept inside the customer’s existing environment: installing and configuring the JVM, running representative workloads, and capturing empirical results the customer trusts.

Prove performance. Plan and run performance-focused engagements: establish benchmarks and success criteria, measure latency, throughput, GC pause behavior and resource efficiency, analyze GC and JIT logs, tune JVM settings, and quantify the improvement Azul delivers against the incumbent.

Win at enterprise scale. Navigate complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise engagements (large production estates, strict SLAs, security and compliance review, and long procurement cycles) coordinating technical validation across many teams and environments.
Present at every altitude. Deliver presentations and demos across all technical levels, from CxOs to hands-on developers, to “make the complex simple” and communicate Azul’s value to each audience.
Respond to technical requirements. Understand and respond to solicited and unsolicited proposals (RFI/RFP) by aligning Azul capabilities against detailed technical and business requirements.
Orchestrate the extended team. Engage Product Management, Engineering, and the CTO office as needed to remove technical blockers and secure the win.
Partner on territory strategy. Work alongside your Account Executive(s) on territory planning: pipeline generation, growing existing accounts, and enabling partners.

sections.title: Technical Competencies
paras: These are the core technical strengths that define a successful Sales Engineer at Azul:
bullets: Java & the JVM. Deep, hands-on knowledge of Java internals and the JVM: class loading, JIT compilation, memory model, and garbage collection. Able to read and reason about GC logs and runtime behavior, not just describe them.

Performance engineering. Practical experience benchmarking, profiling, and tuning JVM-based applications for latency, throughput, and scale; comfortable diagnosing GC pauses, warm-up, jitter, and resource-efficiency issues in production-like conditions.
Hands-on aptitude. Confident on the command line and in customer environments: installing, configuring, and troubleshooting runtimes; able to build and run a POC independently.
Enterprise application stacks. Solid understanding of Java-based applications and frameworks that run on or alongside Azul products (e.g., Cassandra, Kafka, Solr, Spring).
Cloud & containers. Working knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and container/orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
Portfolio SME. Demonstrate SME-level depth and breadth across the entire Azul product suite, and continuously grow technical acumen through enablement, hands-on experimentation, and self-study.

sections.title: Qualifications
bullets: 5+ years in a Sales Engineering / pre-sales role supporting enterprise software, ideally in the Java, middleware, performance, or infrastructure space.
3+ years of hands-on Java development or testing experience with a demonstrable command of Java architecture.
Proven track record of hands-on pilots and POCs and of performance-related engagements where you measured and demonstrated technical results in a customer environment.
Experience selling into large enterprises — complex, multi-stakeholder, mission-critical production environments.
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related IT discipline; a master’s or higher in an IT or business discipline is a plus.

lever:captivateiq:0c138b6b-08ec-428b-8e8.summary:
CaptivateIQ is transforming the way companies plan, manage, and optimize the models that run their business. We started by revolutionizing incentive compensation management, expanded into sales planning, and are building a unified platform for the most critical models an enterprise runs.

CaptivateIQ is looking for a Staff Product Manager – Modeling Platform to define and evolve the foundational modeling capabilities that power products across CaptivateIQ.

Our customers use CaptivateIQ to represent complex business logic: how sales teams earn commissions, how organizations plan headcount and expenses, how revenue is forecast, and how businesses evaluate different scenarios. While these use cases look different on the surface, they depend on many of the same underlying concepts: data, relationships, calculations, models, versions, scenarios, and outputs.

sections.title: What You'll Own
paras: The Modeling Platform is the shared foundation for representing and executing business models across CaptivateIQ.
Your scope will include capabilities such as:

Your job is not to design a modeling system for one product. It is to create the foundation that allows CaptivateIQ to represent many different kinds of business models without rebuilding the modeling paradigm each time.
bullets: Modeling primitives. Define the foundational concepts used to represent models, including objects, relationships, inputs, calculations, outputs, components, dimensions, measures, and other reusable building blocks.
Model structure and composition. Enable customers and product teams to construct sophisticated models from reusable, composable pieces rather than bespoke product-specific logic.
State and planning concepts. Establish consistent ways to represent concepts such as actuals, forecasts, versions, and scenarios across modeling use cases.
Cross-model interoperability. Define how data, assumptions, calculations, and outputs can be shared and referenced across models and products.
Modeling interfaces and contracts. Partner with Engineering to define clear schemas, APIs, behaviors, and guarantees that product teams can reliably build upon.
AI-ready modeling. Ensure models have the structure, semantics, and interfaces necessary for agents to understand, create, explain, and safely modify them.

sections.title: What You'll Do
bullets: Own the Modeling Platform strategy and roadmap. Define the foundational capabilities and primitives that enable CaptivateIQ to represent complex business models across products and domains.

Define durable platform abstractions. Identify common needs across products and determine what belongs in the shared platform versus the consuming product, where abstraction boundaries should sit, and how those capabilities should evolve over time.
Partner deeply with Engineering. Work closely with senior and staff+ engineers on data models, schemas, APIs, system behavior, performance constraints, and architectural tradeoffs.

Ground platform decisions in real modeling problems. Understand how customers represent data, relationships, assumptions, calculations, business logic, scenarios, and outputs across domains such as incentive compensation, sales planning, and FP&A.
Connect platform architecture to product experience. Partner with Design and product teams to turn powerful underlying capabilities into intuitive modeling experiences for business users.

Drive alignment across teams. Bring together Product, Engineering, Design, and domain experts to work through complex problems, surface tradeoffs, and make decisions that create leverage across CaptivateIQ.

Build for an AI-native future. Ensure our modeling platform has the structure, semantics, and interfaces necessary for agents to understand and interact with models while maintaining deterministic execution at its core.

sections.title: What You'll Bring
bullets: 8+ years of product management experience, ideally with platform, data, modeling, analytics, or other technically complex products.
A track record of building shared platform capabilities used across multiple products, teams, or use cases.
Strong technical fluency and the ability to partner deeply with senior engineers on architecture and system design.
Experience with or a strong understanding of modeling systems , including how data, relationships, calculations, and business logic come together to represent real-world systems.
Excellent cross-functional leadership , with a track record of driving clarity and decisions across Engineering, Design, Product, and other stakeholders.
Strong judgment and communication skills, particularly when navigating ambiguous problems and complex tradeoffs.
